title: Riot X Nic Salts Strawberry Melon Chew 10ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Melon Chew from Riot X delivers a playful fusion of sweet, sun-ripened strawberries and juicy melon with a nostalgic chewy candy twist. The balance of berry brightness and the mellow, succulent melon notes creates a layered, satisfying vape with a soft, lingering sweetness. Part of Riot Squad’s Riot X collection, this e-liquid is crafted to replicate the bold, double-concentrated flavours found in the most popular single-use disposables. Supplied in a 10ml bottle, it’s an excellent option for vapers moving from disposables to refillable MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits, offering the same vivid taste experience with the added benefits of convenience and cost-efficiency. Riot X Salt E-Liquids are made with Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine blend, a combination of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. This innovative mix, along with the 50PG/50VG ratio, ensures a smooth yet flavourful inhale with a balanced throat hit and satisfying vapour production. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
